description: Customer dashboard (replaces AccountView placeholder) and reviews feature. Depends on FEAT-001 (types, CSS, lib/reviews.ts) and FEAT-002 (OrdersView already exists; this feature links to /orders). These are grouped because they both live inside the /account section and share the AccountDashboard shell.
steps: 1. Replace components/auth/AccountView.tsx with full AccountDashboard. Keep same export name 'AccountView' so app/(site)/account/page.tsx needs no changes. Structure: 'use client', auth guard (same pattern as existing — useEffect redirect to /login?next=/account if ready && !user). Render .oi-view .oi-container. Inside: .oi-dashboard grid. Left: .oi-sidebar with .oi-sidebar__brand (Logo size='sm'), .oi-sidebar__label 'MY ACCOUNT', .oi-sidebar__nav with 5 nav items as <Link> (NOT buttons) styled as .oi-sidebar__link — applying is-active class via pathname comparison with usePathname(): Overview→/account (exact), Orders→/orders, Wishlist→/wishlist, Reviews→/account/reviews, Settings→/account/settings. Bottom: .oi-sidebar__profile with avatar span + name + email. Right: .oi-dashboard__content. Overview content (only shown at exactly /account): .oi-account-banner (green gradient welcome strip with initials avatar, 'Welcome back, {firstName}', member since date). Below banner: .oi-metrics with 3 stat cards: Orders placed (count from oilinga_orders localStorage), Wishlist items (count from oilinga_wishlist localStorage), Reviews written (count from oilinga_reviews localStorage) — read each on client mount. Below stats: recent orders mini-table: .oi-dash-card with .oi-card-head (title 'Recent orders', link 'View all →' to /orders), .oi-table-wrap > .oi-table with columns ORDER, DATE, TOTAL, STATUS — last 3 orders from oilinga_orders localStorage, each row's ORDER is a link to /orders/[id], STATUS uses Badge with correct tone. If no orders: small muted text 'No orders yet'. Sign-out button in sidebar profile or as a secondary action in the banner area.
2. Create app/(site)/account/settings/page.tsx: server component, metadata title 'Account settings', renders <AccountSettings />.

3. Create components/auth/AccountSettings.tsx ('use client'): auth guard same pattern. Renders inside .oi-view .oi-container with .oi-dashboard layout (same sidebar as AccountView — extract sidebar into a shared AccountSidebarNav component to avoid duplication). Main content: page heading 'Account settings'. Two .oi-form-section blocks: (a) Profile — name input (pre-filled from user.name), email input (read-only, type='email'), save button → reads current accounts from localStorage, finds by email, updates name + initials, updates session, calls notify('Profile saved'). (b) Password change — current password, new password (min 8 chars), confirm new password inputs. Validate: current matches stored, new === confirm, length check. On success: update stored password, clear fields, notify('Password updated'). On error: show inline error message. Each field uses .oi-form-group / .oi-form-label / .oi-form-input.

4. Extract shared sidebar nav into components/auth/AccountSidebarNav.tsx ('use client') to avoid duplicating the nav in AccountView, AccountSettings, and AccountReviews. Props: none (reads user from useAuth() internally, uses usePathname() for active state). Renders the .oi-sidebar block. Update AccountView (step 1) and AccountSettings (step 3) to use <AccountSidebarNav />.

5. Create components/views/AccountReviews.tsx ('use client'): auth guard. Renders inside .oi-dashboard layout using <AccountSidebarNav />. Main content: page heading 'Your reviews'. Reads oilinga_reviews localStorage. Empty state: 'You haven't written any reviews yet' + ButtonLink to /marketplace. Review list: each .oi-review-card shows product name (Link to /products/[slug]), StarRating with rating, date, review text. Below list (or at top): 'Write a review' button that expands inline <ReviewForm> with a product slug selector (select input populated from products array in lib/data.ts) or from a URL query param ?product=[slug] (pre-selects that product). On submit: calls writeReview from lib/reviews.ts, re-reads reviews, notify('Review submitted').
6. Create app/(site)/account/reviews/page.tsx: server component, title 'Your reviews', renders <AccountReviews />.

7. Create components/ui/ReviewForm.tsx ('use client'): props: productSlug (string), productName (string), authorName (string), onSubmit?: () => void. State: rating (number 0–5), text (string). Interactive star picker: 5 .oi-star-picker__star buttons; clicking star N sets rating to N (and all 1..N get is-active class). Textarea for review text. Submit button: validates rating > 0 and text.length >= 10; calls writeReview({ id: crypto.randomUUID(), productSlug, productName, rating, text, date: new Date().toISOString(), authorName }); calls onSubmit?.(); notify('Review submitted'); resets form. Import writeReview from lib/reviews.ts.

8. Modify app/(site)/products/[slug]/page.tsx: add a ProductReviews section below the related products Section component. Create components/marketplace/ProductReviews.tsx ('use client') that takes productSlug and productName as props. On mount reads reviewsForProduct(productSlug) from lib/reviews.ts. Shows average rating (if reviews exist), list of .oi-review-card items, and an expandable 'Write a review' section (shows <ReviewForm> when button clicked, guarded by useAuth — shows sign-in prompt if not logged in). Section wrapper uses .oi-reviews-section class. In the page, import and render: <ProductReviews productSlug={product.slug} productName={product.name} /> (this is a client component inserted into a server page — that is fine in Next.js App Router).
acceptance_criteria: Visiting /account shows AccountDashboard with sidebar nav and Overview content (welcome banner, 3 stat cards, recent orders table)
Sidebar nav links are active-highlighted based on current pathname
Visiting /account/settings shows profile form and password form; saving shows toast
Visiting /account/reviews shows reviews list or empty state; 'Write a review' flow works
ProductReviews section appears on /products/[slug] with review list and form
ReviewForm submits to oilinga_reviews localStorage and shows toast
AccountSidebarNav is shared across all account pages (no sidebar duplication)
yarn build exits 0 with no TypeScript errors
verification: cd /Users/mac/Desktop/oilinga && yarn build — must exit 0 with no TypeScript errors
findings: All account dashboard, settings, and review components implemented. Key details: (1) AccountSidebarNav is a shared client component used by AccountView, AccountSettings, and AccountReviews — no sidebar duplication. (2) AccountView replaces the old placeholder with a full dashboard: welcome banner, 3 stat cards reading from oilinga_orders/oilinga_wishlist/oilinga_reviews localStorage keys, and a recent orders mini-table showing last 3 orders. (3) AccountSettings provides profile editing (name, read-only email) and password change with inline validation. (4) AccountReviews lists all reviews from oilinga_reviews, supports inline ReviewForm with product selector (pre-selects via ?product=[slug] query param). (5) ReviewForm uses an interactive star picker (hover + click) and validates rating > 0 and text >= 10 chars before writing to localStorage via writeReview(). (6) ProductReviews is added to /products/[slug] below related products — shows avg rating, review list, and expandable write-review form guarded by auth (shows sign-in link if not authenticated). (7) /account/reviews/page.tsx is wrapped in <Suspense> because AccountReviews uses useSearchParams(). (8) yarn build exits 0 with no TypeScript errors — all 38 static pages generated successfully. localStorage keys in use: oilinga_orders (CustomerOrder[]), oilinga_wishlist (WishlistItem[]), oilinga_reviews (Review[]).
